newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices steady in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices steady in dull trade.

text.p: Cotton prices were steady in sluggish trade on Tuesday as mills stayed on the sidelines, dealers said.
"There is not much activity in the market," said a dealer.
He said a state agency that had been authorised to export 100,000 bales of cotton had called for tenders for June 14.
"Once the export deals are finalised there could be some activity in the market," the dealer said.
In spot, Bengal-deshi was steady at 1,010/1,030 rupees per maund (37.32 kg). F-414 was offered at 2,110 rupees per maund.
Gujarat Kalyan (medium-staple) was quoted at 14,500/14,700 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).
